note: Pre-registration of H-a (disclosure restatement quality) analysis BEFORE full-universe results. Fixes primary signal, variant grid (n_trials), null, and PIT rule to prevent post-hoc cherry-picking. Full-data numbers filled by ha_measure_part2.R against ha_results.rds.
hypothesis: H-a: frequent restatement (기재정정) filings = poor disclosure quality / weak internal controls -> avoid (exclusion). Direction: quality = -restatement_rate (low restatement = long / keep).
economic_rationale: Financial/disclosure restatements signal low reporting quality, governance weakness, earnings management -> subsequent underperformance (Palmrose-Richardson-Scholz 2004 JAE; Hribar-Jenkins 2004 RAS). KR-native, non-price, PIT-clean via DART rcept_dt (receipt timestamp), long history to 2005.
PIT_rule: signal at month-end sig_date t uses only filings with rcept_dt <= t (public receipt date); forward return = realized month t+1. No concurrent-month look-ahead. Trailing windows 12M/24M.
primary_signal: q_rate24 = -(restatement_count_24M / total_filings_24M), defined only for firms with fil_24>=4 (has_hist).
primary_book_marginal_form: ex_q80 = exclude firms with rate_24 >= IS(2005-2018) top-quintile threshold from score_eff top-25 candidate pool.
selection_type: hypothesis-family sweep (H-a sub-variants). DSR reported as diagnostic; empirical null from placebo random-exclusion (200 draws).
null_maxt: max |NW-t| across the 7 variants compared to empirical placebo null q95 (random exclusion matching monthly count). Pre-registered: signal is credible only if primary ex_q80 NW-t exceeds placebo q95 AND survives lag1 stress AND IS-sign held into OOS.
authority: canonical PORT_t (cap-w, forge-analogue via canonical_screen_bt) is screening authority for standalone; book-marginal paired NW-t(lag3) + dIR(net_active) is primary lever. rank-IC = advisory only. Graduation authority = forge (not this stage).
